meta.name: story-deslop
meta.description: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 去除网文的AI腔调，让段落像真人写就
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果写的网文常常读起来像AI生成，想把语气改得更像真人。
copy.tagline_en: Strip AI-flavored writing from web fiction for a natural, human tone.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your web fiction often reads like AI output and you want a more human voice.

howto.what: 把网文中检测出的人工智能味表达（套话、工整句、心理直说等）改成更自然、去模板化的写法，保留剧情、人设和专有名词；会先给出人工智能味等级与问题标记，再输出修改前后对比和润色后文本。
howto.when: 当你说“去人工智能味”或“这篇太人工智能了”，或输入 /story-deslop 命令时触发。

say.text: 这段文太人工智能了，帮我改自然点，别动剧情和人物。
say.note: 会先扫描，再按规则逐处润色并给对比。

say.text: 只检测有没有人工智能味，不要改原文。
say.note: 只输出等级和问题标记，不改动文字。

say.text: 全文去一遍人工智能味，重点处理排比和结尾升华。
say.note: 会执行分级删除上限，给出修改统计与全文结果。

howto.what_en: Rewrites AI-flavored web novel text (cliches, overly neat sentences, direct tellings of emotion) into more natural, non-template prose while preserving plot, characters and names; first reports an AI-flavor level and issue marks, then shows before/after comparison and final text.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say “remove AI flavor” or “this reads too AI”, or type /story-deslop.

say_en.text: This passage reads too AI. Rewrite it naturally, keeping the story and characters unchanged.
say_en.note: It scans, polishes, and shows the before/after.

say_en.text: Only check for AI flavor. Do not edit the text.
say_en.note: Outputs only severity and issue marks.

say_en.text: Remove AI flavor from the whole thing, focusing on parallel structures and uplifting endings.
say_en.note: Runs the full cleanup and gives the report.
